expected_findings.description: The <= comparison computes a longest non-decreasing subsequence; strict LIS requires values[j] < values[i]. Equal values are incorrectly chained.
The nested predecessor scan is O(n^2), which is not suitable for n up to 20,000; the task requires O(n log n).

note: Regression oracle for strictness and asymptotic runtime defects. Keep this instructor-side oracle separate from model input.
